topics.label: Introduction to the complement system lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing the complement system and acknowledging its complexity and nomenclature.

topics.label: Foundational concepts, nomenclature, and central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational principles, naming conventions, and central biochemical role of component C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways and threshold
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct pathways that recognize pathogens and converge to reach the critical threshold for complement activation.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the downstream effector mechanisms triggered by complement activation to eliminate pathogens and stimulate inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host cell protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the regulatory proteins and inhibitory mechanisms that prevent complement from attacking and damaging host tissues.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the distinct clinical presentations and disease phenotypes associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement immunity
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how pathogens, particularly Staphylococcus aureus, have evolved specific mechanisms to circumvent complement-mediated clearance.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of upcoming topics
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the discussion on complement and outlines the topic for the following lecture.
